title.zh: 卷311 列傳九十八 哈攀龙 任举 冶大雄 马良柱 本进忠 刘顺
title.en: Volume 311 Biographies 98: Ha Pan Long, Ren Ju, Ye Da Xiong, Ma Liangzhu, Ben Jin Zhong, Liu Shun
title.raw: 卷311 列傳九十八 哈攀龙 任举 冶大雄 马良柱 本进忠 刘顺

sentences.zh: 列傳九十八

translations.literal: Biographies 98
translations.idiomatic: Biographies 98

sentences.zh: 哈攀龍子國興任舉冶大雄馬良柱本進忠劉順

translations.literal: Ha Panlong, Guo Xing, Ren Ju, Ye Daxiong, Ma Liangzhu, Ben Jinzhong, Liu Shun
translations.idiomatic: Ha Panlong, Guo Xing, Ren Ju, Ye Daxiong, Ma Liangzhu, Ben Jinzhong, and Liu Shun

sentences.zh: 哈攀龍，直隸河間人，其先出回部。

translations.literal: Ha Panlong was a native of Hejian in Zhili; his ancestors came from the Hui communities.
translations.idiomatic: Ha Panlong was from Hejian in Zhili; his family originally came from the Muslim communities.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二年一甲一名武進士，授頭等侍衛。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qianlong he took first place in the top tier of the military metropolitan examination and was appointed a First-Class Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In 1737 he ranked first among the top-tier military graduates and was appointed a First-Class Bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 以副將發福建，除興化城守副將。

translations.literal: He was dispatched to Fujian as a brigade deputy commander and appointed deputy garrison commander of Xinghua.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent to Fujian as a brigade deputy commander and made deputy commander of the Xinghua garrison.

sentences.zh: 遷總兵，歷河南南陽，福建海壇、漳州諸鎮。

translations.literal: He was promoted to regional commander and served successively at Nanyang in Henan and at Haicheng and Zhangzhou in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted to regional commander, he served in turn at Nanyang in Henan and at Haicheng and Zhangzhou in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 以母喪去官。

translations.literal: He resigned office on account of his mother's death.
translations.idiomatic: He left office to observe mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 十三年，高宗東巡，攀龍迎鑾，命往金川，隸總督張廣泗軍，署松潘鎮總兵。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, when Emperor Gaozong toured the east, Panlong welcomed the imperial carriage; he was ordered to proceed to Jinchuan, placed under Governor-General Zhang Guangsi's army, and appointed acting regional commander of Songpan.
translations.idiomatic: In 1748, when the emperor toured the east, Panlong welcomed the imperial procession and was ordered to Jinchuan under Zhang Guangsi, with acting command of the Songpan garrison.

sentences.zh: 出美諾溝，取撒臥山、大松林、噶達諸寨。

translations.literal: He marched out from Meinuo Ravine and captured Sawo Mountain, Great Pine Forest, Gada, and other stockades.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing from Meinuo Ravine, he took Sawo Mountain, Great Pine Forest, Gada, and other rebel strongholds.

sentences.zh: 分兵出馬溝右梁，察形勢，得其險要，搜截松林，賊蔽松設卡。

translations.literal: Dividing his forces he sent troops out from the right ridge of Magou Ravine to reconnoiter the terrain, seized its strategic points, and searched and cut off the Pine Forest; the rebels hid in the pines and set up barriers.
translations.idiomatic: He detached troops along the right ridge of Magou Ravine to scout the ground, seized the key positions, and swept the pine woods where rebels had hidden and set up barriers.

sentences.zh: 毀其二，徑左梁山溝，砲斃賊數十。

translations.literal: He destroyed two of them, advanced along Zuoliang Mountain Ravine, and killed several dozen rebels with artillery.
translations.idiomatic: He destroyed two barriers, pushed up Zuoliang Mountain Ravine, and killed dozens of rebels with cannon fire.

sentences.zh: 進克渴足寨，焚碉寨四、水城一，殺賊二十餘。

translations.literal: He pressed on to capture Kezu stockade, burning four blockhouses and stockades and one water fortress, killing more than twenty rebels.
translations.idiomatic: He then took Kezu stockade, burning four blockhouses, one water fort, and killing more than twenty rebels.

sentences.zh: 尋與署重慶鎮總兵任舉合兵攻色爾力石城，舉沒於陣。

translations.literal: Soon he joined Acting Chongqing Regional Commander Ren Ju in attacking the Serli stone fortress; Ju perished in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he joined Acting Chongqing Commander Ren Ju in assaulting the stone fortress at Serli; Ju was killed in action.

sentences.zh: 攀龍入林，殪賊三十餘，奪舉屍回。

translations.literal: Panlong entered the forest, killed more than thirty rebels, and recovered Ju's body.
translations.idiomatic: Panlong fought into the woods, killed more than thirty rebels, and brought Ju's body back.

sentences.zh: 复偕都統班第、署重慶鎮總兵段起賢、侍衛富成分道夜襲色爾力，焚木卡三，殺賊五十餘。

translations.literal: Again he joined Banner Commander Ban Di, Acting Chongqing Regional Commander Duan Qixian, and Bodyguard Fu Cheng in a night attack on Serli by separate routes, burned three wooden barriers, and killed more than fifty rebels.
translations.idiomatic: He again joined Ban Di, Duan Qixian, and Fu Cheng in a night assault on Serli by separate routes, burning three wooden barriers and killing more than fifty rebels.

sentences.zh: 進破石梁、雙溝諸壘。

translations.literal: He advanced and broke the stockades at Shiliang and Shuanggou.
translations.idiomatic: He pressed forward and broke the fortifications at Shiliang and Shuanggou.

sentences.zh: 經略訥親、總督張廣泗劾攀龍攻色爾力不能下，兵部議左遷。

translations.literal: Commissioner Neqin and Governor-General Zhang Guangsi memorialized that Panlong could not take Serli; the Ministry of War recommended demotion.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner Neqin and Zhang Guangsi accused Panlong of failing to capture Serli; the Ministry of War recommended his demotion.

sentences.zh: 上責攀龍自陳，攀龍言屢克卡殺賊報廣泗，廣泗不以入告。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Panlong to state his own case; Panlong said he had repeatedly captured barriers and killed rebels and reported this to Guangsi, but Guangsi did not include it in his reports.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor required Panlong to explain himself; Panlong said he had repeatedly reported captures and kills to Guangsi, who had not passed those reports upward.

sentences.zh: 會訥親、廣泗皆得罪去，上知攀龍枉，命罷議。

translations.literal: When Neqin and Guangsi were both dismissed for offenses, the emperor learned Panlong had been wronged and ordered the demotion proceedings halted.
translations.idiomatic: When Neqin and Guangsi were both removed for misconduct, the emperor saw that Panlong had been wronged and halted the demotion proceedings.

sentences.zh: 尋從經略大學士傅恆夜攻色爾力，先登，拔石卡，殪賊數十。

translations.literal: Soon he joined Commissioner Grand Secretary Fu Heng in a night attack on Serli, was first to ascend, captured the stone barrier, and killed several dozen rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he joined Grand Secretary Fu Heng in a night assault on Serli, was first over the wall, took the stone barrier, and killed dozens of rebels.

sentences.zh: 十四年，金川事定，命署固原提督。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year the Jinchuan campaign was settled; he was appointed acting provincial military commander of Guyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In 1749, after the Jinchuan campaign ended, he was appointed acting provincial commander at Guyuan.

sentences.zh: 十六年，移湖廣提督，陳整飭弁兵諸事，上嘉勉之。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was transferred to provincial military commander of Huguang and submitted memorials on various matters of tightening discipline among officers and troops; the emperor praised and encouraged him.
translations.idiomatic: In 1751 he was transferred to Huguang as provincial commander and memorialized on tightening discipline among officers and men; the emperor commended him.

sentences.zh: 尋命真除。

translations.literal: He was soon ordered to receive regular appointment.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon confirmed in the post.

sentences.zh: 复移貴州提督。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to provincial military commander of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was then transferred again to Guizhou as provincial commander.

sentences.zh: 入陛見，病留京師，卒。

translations.literal: He came to court for audience, fell ill and remained in the capital, and died.
translations.idiomatic: He came to court for audience, fell ill in the capital, and died there.

sentences.zh: 子國興，乾隆十七年武進士，授三等侍衛。

translations.literal: His son Guo Xing passed the military metropolitan examination in the seventeenth year of Qianlong and was appointed a Third-Class Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: His son Guo Xing passed the military metropolitan examination in 1752 and was appointed a Third-Class Bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 出為雲南督標右營游擊，遷東川營參將。

translations.literal: He was sent out as battalion colonel of the right column of the governor-general's command in Yunnan and was transferred to garrison colonel of Dongchuan.
translations.idiomatic: He was posted to Yunnan as colonel of the governor-general's right battalion and later promoted to garrison colonel at Dongchuan.

sentences.zh: 緬甸頭人召散據孟艮為亂。

translations.literal: The Burmese leader Zhao San seized Menggen and rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: The Burmese chieftain Zhao San seized Menggen and rose in revolt.

sentences.zh: 總督楊應琚檄國興佐軍，戰楞木，進克猛卯，督戰被槍，創右輔及臂。

translations.literal: Governor-General Yang Yingju ordered Guo Xing to assist the army; they fought at Lengmu, advanced to capture Mengmeng, and while directing the fighting he was shot and wounded in the right temple and arm.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Yang Yingju ordered Guo Xing to join the campaign; at Lengmu and in the capture of Mengmeng he led from the front, was shot, and wounded in the right temple and arm.

sentences.zh: 應琚以聞，賜孔雀翎。

translations.literal: Yingju reported this and Guo Xing was granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: Yingju reported the feat, and Guo Xing was awarded the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 尋署騰越營副將。

translations.literal: He was soon appointed acting brigade deputy commander of the Tengyue garrison.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made acting deputy commander of the Tengyue garrison.

sentences.zh: 時副將趙宏榜以偏師深入，與緬人戰於新街，師敗績。

translations.literal: At that time Brigade Deputy Commander Zhao Hongbang led a detached column deep in and was defeated by the Burmese at Xinjie.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Deputy Commander Zhao Hongbang led a detached force deep into enemy country and was routed by the Burmese at Xinjie.

sentences.zh: 國興師至蠻暮，诇新街無備，督兵潛入，緬人乃引退。

translations.literal: Guo Xing's army reached Manmu; learning Xinjie was undefended, he led his troops in secretly; the Burmese then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Xing marched to Manmu, learned that Xinjie was undefended, led his men in by stealth, and the Burmese withdrew.

sentences.zh: 從將軍明瑞進克木邦，戰於蠻暮，大破之。

translations.literal: Following General Ming Rui he advanced to capture Mubang and fought at Manmu, inflicting a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Under General Ming Rui he helped capture Mubang and won a major victory at Manmu.

sentences.zh: 复偕侍衛莽克察擊斬守隘賊六十餘。

translations.literal: He again joined Bodyguard Mangkecha in attacking and killing more than sixty rebels guarding passes.
translations.idiomatic: He again joined Bodyguard Mangkecha in storming the passes and killing more than sixty defenders.

sentences.zh: 擢楚姚鎮總兵。

translations.literal: He was promoted to regional commander of Chuyao.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to regional commander at Chuyao.

sentences.zh: 入陛見，命在乾清門行走，賚銀幣。

translations.literal: He came to court for audience and was ordered to serve in attendance at the Gate of Celestial Purity; he was bestowed silver and coins.
translations.idiomatic: At court audience he was ordered to serve at the Gate of Celestial Purity and was granted silver and coin.

sentences.zh: 還軍，移普洱鎮總兵，遷貴州提督。

translations.literal: Returning to the army, he was transferred to regional commander of Pu'er and then to provincial military commander of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to the field, he was made commander at Pu'er and then provincial commander of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 經略傅恆議用水師，令國興赴銅壁關外野人山督造船。

translations.literal: Commissioner Fu Heng decided to use a naval force and ordered Guo Xing to proceed beyond Tongbi Pass to the Wild Man Mountains to supervise shipbuilding.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner Fu Heng decided on a naval campaign and sent Guo Xing beyond Tongbi Pass to the Wild Man Mountains to supervise construction of the fleet.

sentences.zh: 移雲南提督，加太子少保。

translations.literal: He was transferred to provincial military commander of Yunnan and granted the title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Yunnan as provincial commander and given the title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 船成，從傅恆出猛拱、孟養、南豐、猛烈、猛壩，次老官屯。

translations.literal: When the ships were completed he followed Fu Heng through Menggong, Mengyang, Nanfeng, Menglie, and Mengban, halting at Laoguantun.
translations.idiomatic: When the fleet was ready he followed Fu Heng through Menggong, Mengyang, Nanfeng, Menglie, and Mengban, and camped at Laoguantun.

sentences.zh: 緬人水陸備甚固，攻之不時下。

translations.literal: The Burmese defenses on land and water were very strong and could not be taken at once.
translations.idiomatic: Burmese defenses on land and water were formidable, and the positions could not be taken quickly.

sentences.zh: 頭人諾爾塔以其酋懵駁命，遣使得魯蘊詣軍乞解兵。

translations.literal: The leader Nuerta, on the orders of his chief Meng Ba, sent an envoy Deluyun to the army to request withdrawal.
translations.idiomatic: Chieftain Nuerta, acting for his lord Meng Ba, sent the envoy Deluyun to the army to ask for withdrawal of the troops.

sentences.zh: 傅恆令國興出見，曉以利害，令具約十年一貢，毋更擾邊，歸所掠內地人。

translations.literal: Fu Heng had Guo Xing go out to meet him, explained advantages and disadvantages, and required a treaty of tribute once every ten years, no further border harassment, and return of people seized from the interior.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Heng had Guo Xing meet the envoy, explain the stakes, and require a treaty pledging tribute every ten years, an end to border raids, and the return of captives taken from Qing territory.

sentences.zh: 緬人誓奉約。

translations.literal: The Burmese swore to abide by the treaty.
translations.idiomatic: The Burmese swore to uphold the agreement.

sentences.zh: 時傅恆方病，將軍阿桂召從征諸大臣議，皆言許之便，遂與定約解兵。

translations.literal: At that time Fu Heng was ill; General Agui summoned the ministers on campaign to deliberate; all said it would be expedient to agree, and they settled the treaty and withdrew the army.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Heng was then ill; General Agui called the ministers on campaign to council, and all agreed acceptance was expedient; they concluded the treaty and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 既而貢弗至，總督彰寶遣都司蘇爾相諭意，留不遣，揚言國興許以木邦、猛拱、蠻暮三土司予緬人，請如議。

translations.literal: Afterward tribute did not arrive; Governor Zhang Bao sent Company Commander Su Erxiang to convey his meaning; Su was detained and it was proclaimed that Guo Xing had promised the three native offices of Mubang, Menggong, and Manmu to the Burmese, requesting fulfillment of the agreement.
translations.idiomatic: When tribute failed to arrive, Governor Zhang Bao sent Company Commander Su Erxiang to state Qing demands; Su was detained, and the Burmese claimed Guo Xing had promised them the three chieftaincies of Mubang, Menggong, and Manmu and asked that the bargain be honored.

sentences.zh: 彰寶劾國興與緬人議具約不以實，上召國興至京師，詰國興，國興自陳未嘗有此議。

translations.literal: Zhang Bao memorialized that Guo Xing's negotiations with the Burmese had not been truthful; the emperor summoned Guo Xing to the capital and questioned him; Guo Xing stated he had never made such an agreement.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Bao accused Guo Xing of misrepresenting the treaty negotiations; the emperor summoned him to Beijing and questioned him; Guo Xing denied ever having made such a promise.

sentences.zh: 上責國興遷就畢事，奪太子少保，左授貴州古州鎮總兵。

translations.literal: The emperor blamed Guo Xing for compromising to finish the affair; he was stripped of Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and demoted to regional commander of Guzhou in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor blamed Guo Xing for settling the affair too readily; he was stripped of Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and demoted to regional commander at Guzhou in Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 移雲南臨元鎮。

translations.literal: He was transferred to regional commander of Linyuan in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to command the Linyuan garrison in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 後二年，得魯蘊復至老官屯，請如前誓三事。

translations.literal: Two years later Deluyun again came to Laoguantun and requested the same three matters as before per the oath.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later Deluyun returned to Laoguantun and asked again for the three pledges of the original oath.

sentences.zh: 時師徵金川，上命國興從將軍溫福進討。

translations.literal: At that time the army was campaigning against Jinchuan; the emperor ordered Guo Xing to follow General Wen Fu on the expedition.
translations.idiomatic: The army was then campaigning in Jinchuan; the emperor ordered Guo Xing to join General Wen Fu in the advance.

sentences.zh: 三十七年，遷西安提督，命盡護陝西、甘肅從征諸軍。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year he was transferred to provincial military commander of Xi'an and ordered to oversee in full the armies of Shaanxi and Gansu on campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In 1772 he was made provincial commander at Xi'an and placed in overall charge of the Shaanxi and Gansu forces on campaign.

sentences.zh: 尋令偕總兵董天弼自曾頭溝取底木達、布朗郭宗。

translations.literal: He was soon ordered to join Regional Commander Dong Tianbi in taking Dimuda and Bulangguozong from Zengtougou Ravine.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon ordered to join Regional Commander Dong Tianbi in taking Dimuda and Bulangguozong via Zengtougou Ravine.

sentences.zh: 溫福以國興能軍，令自策卜丹徑取美諾當一面。

translations.literal: Wen Fu, because Guo Xing was capable in warfare, ordered him on his own to take a direct route from Zebudan to strike at Meinuo on one flank.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Fu, judging Guo Xing an able field commander, ordered him to strike Meinuo from Zebudan on an independent axis.

sentences.zh: 國興自阿喀木雅山溝紆道徑瑪爾迪克山寨，察策卜丹地勢，林深徑狹，不宜於行師，乃將二千人佐海蘭察攻瑪爾迪克。

translations.literal: Guo Xing by a winding route through Akemuya Mountain Ravine went straight to Ma'erdike stockade mountain, reconnoitered the terrain of Zebudan, found the forest deep and paths narrow and unsuitable for marching troops, and therefore assigned two thousand men to assist Hailancha in attacking Ma'erdike.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Xing took a detour through Akemuya Mountain Ravine to Ma'erdike stockade, reconnoitered Zebudan, found the woods too dense and the paths too narrow for a main column, and sent two thousand men to support Hailancha against Ma'erdike.

sentences.zh: 溫福再疏聞上。

translations.literal: Wen Fu again memorialized the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Fu reported this again to the throne.

sentences.zh: 金川賊千餘屯貢噶山左，謀劫糧，國興馳擊，賊敗匿。

translations.literal: More than a thousand Jinchuan rebels were stationed on the left of Gongga Mountain planning to raid supplies; Guo Xing galloped to attack and the rebels were defeated and hid.
translations.idiomatic: More than a thousand Jinchuan rebels massed on the left flank of Gongga Mountain to ambush supply trains; Guo Xing rode out to attack and drove them into hiding.

sentences.zh: 師還，經瑪爾迪克，賊自林中出，复擊敗之，上賚荷包四。

translations.literal: When the army returned past Ma'erdike, rebels emerged from the forest; he attacked again and defeated them; the emperor bestowed four purses.
translations.idiomatic: On the return march past Ma'erdike rebels sprang from the woods; he beat them back again, and the emperor granted him four reward purses.

sentences.zh: 進攻貢噶山，設伏，斬賊百餘，搜箐奪碉卡。

translations.literal: He advanced to attack Gongga Mountain, set an ambush, beheaded more than a hundred rebels, searched ravines and seized blockhouse-barriers.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced on Gongga Mountain, laid an ambush, killed more than a hundred rebels, swept the ravines, and seized blockhouses and barriers.

sentences.zh: 九月，金川酋索諾木使詣國興，請獻鄂克什地以降。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Jinchuan chieftain Suonuomu sent envoys to Guo Xing offering to surrender E'keshi territory.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the Jinchuan chief Suonuomu sent envoys to Guo Xing offering to surrender the territory of E'keshi.

sentences.zh: 國興令並割南北兩山美美卡、木蘭壩及瑪爾迪克。

translations.literal: Guo Xing required in addition the cession of Meimeika, Mulanba, and Ma'erdike on the southern and northern mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Xing demanded as well the cession of Meimeika, Mulanba, and Ma'erdike on the northern and southern ranges.

sentences.zh: 越日，賊盡撤諸柵。

translations.literal: The next day the rebels withdrew all their palisades.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the rebels pulled down all their palisades.

sentences.zh: 國興以兵入鄂克什舊寨，賊退守路頂宗。

translations.literal: Guo Xing led troops into the old E'keshi stockade; the rebels retreated to defend Ludingzong.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Xing marched into the old E'keshi stockade; the rebels fell back to Ludingzong.

sentences.zh: 十月，使歸墨壟溝師敗時所掠外委臧儒，且言嘗勸僧格桑同降。

translations.literal: In the tenth month they returned Deputy Commissioner Zang Ru seized when the army was defeated at Molong Ravine, and stated they had urged Senggesang to surrender together.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month they returned Deputy Commissioner Zang Ru, captured when the army was beaten at Molong Ravine, and said they had urged Senggesang to surrender with them.

sentences.zh: 溫福以聞，上令國興檄諭索諾木聲其罪。

translations.literal: Wen Fu reported this; the emperor ordered Guo Xing to issue a proclamation denouncing Suonuomu's crimes.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Fu reported this; the emperor ordered Guo Xing to send a proclamation listing Suonuomu's crimes.

sentences.zh: 時國興及海蘭察將五千人屯貢噶山，謀攻策卜丹，阻冰雪未進。

translations.literal: At that time Guo Xing and Hailancha with five thousand men were stationed at Gongga Mountain planning to attack Zebudan but were blocked by ice and snow and did not advance.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Xing and Hailancha then had five thousand men at Gongga Mountain planning an attack on Zebudan, but ice and snow held them back.

sentences.zh: 上命還師攻路頂宗。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered the army to return and attack Ludingzong.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered them to turn back and assault Ludingzong.

sentences.zh: 路頂宗山麓有巨溝，溝源出南山。

translations.literal: At the foot of Ludingzong Mountain was a great ravine whose source issued from the southern mountain.
translations.idiomatic: At the foot of Ludingzong stood a great ravine fed from the southern heights.

sentences.zh: 海蘭察紆道出山後，侍衛額森特自小徑為應，國興前越溝攻碉。

translations.literal: Hailancha took a winding route to emerge behind the mountain; Bodyguard Esente took a small path as coordinated force; Guo Xing crossed the ravine in front to attack the blockhouse.
translations.idiomatic: Hailancha circled behind the mountain; Bodyguard Esente took a side path in support; Guo Xing crossed the ravine in front to storm the blockhouse.

sentences.zh: 師繼進，遂克路頂宗，破卡五十餘、碉三百餘，俘獲甚眾。

translations.literal: The army pressed forward and took Ludingzong, breaking more than fifty barriers and more than three hundred blockhouses, with many captives.
translations.idiomatic: The main force pressed on, took Ludingzong, broke more than fifty barriers and three hundred blockhouses, and captured a great number of prisoners.

sentences.zh: 復自喀木色爾北山攻穆拉斯郭大寨，進據兜烏山巔，與總兵馬彪軍合，奪附近碉卡，克額爾奔木柵。

translations.literal: He again attacked from the northern mountain at Kamise'er the great stockade at Mulasiguo, advanced to hold the summit of Douwu Mountain, joined forces with Regional Commander Ma Biao's army, seized nearby blockhouse-barriers, and captured the E'erbenmu palisade.
translations.idiomatic: He again attacked the great stockade at Mulasiguo from the Kamise'er north ridge, seized the summit of Douwu Mountain, joined Regional Commander Ma Biao, took nearby blockhouses, and captured the E'erbenmu palisade.

sentences.zh: 復將千人渡水，自南山鄂爾濟仰攻，克諸寨，與大軍會，進攻明郭宗。

translations.literal: He again led a thousand men across the water and attacked from E'erjiyang on the southern mountain, captured the various stockades, joined the main army, and advanced to attack Mingguozong.
translations.idiomatic: He led a thousand men across the river, struck from E'erjiyang on the southern slope, took the outlying stockades, rejoined the main army, and advanced on Mingguozong.

sentences.zh: 別以兵襲擊公雅山，克木爾古魯寨，並奪據嘉巴山麓。

translations.literal: Separately he sent troops in a surprise attack on Gongya Mountain, captured Mu'ergulu stockade, and seized positions at the foot of Jiaba Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In a separate column he raided Gongya Mountain, took Mu'ergulu stockade, and seized the foothills of Jiaba Mountain.

sentences.zh: 廷議既定小金川，分命將帥三道進討金川。

translations.literal: Once court deliberation had settled Lesser Jinchuan, the emperor assigned commanders on three routes to advance against Great Jinchuan.
translations.idiomatic: Once the court had settled Lesser Jinchuan, commanders were assigned on three routes to advance against Great Jinchuan.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「國興雖綠營漢員，熟軍事；

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Though Guo Xing is a Han officer of the Green Standard Army, he is skilled in military affairs;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Though Guo Xing is a Han officer of the Green Standard Army, he knows warfare well;

sentences.zh: 又嘗為乾清門侍衛，與滿洲大臣無異。

translations.literal: and he once served as a Bodyguard at the Gate of Celestial Purity, no different from Manchu grand ministers."
translations.idiomatic: and he once served at the Gate of Celestial Purity as a bodyguard, no different in standing from a Manchu grand minister."

sentences.zh: 」授參贊大臣，佐副將軍豐升額。

translations.literal: He was appointed Assistant Commissioner and aided Deputy General Feng Sheng'e.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed assistant commissioner to aid Deputy General Feng Sheng'e.

sentences.zh: 是月克明郭宗，焚念經樓。

translations.literal: That month they captured Mingguozong and burned the scripture hall.
translations.idiomatic: That month they took Mingguozong and burned the scripture hall.

sentences.zh: 整兵進取日果爾烏谷山麓，攻美諾。

translations.literal: They reorganized the army and advanced to take the foothills of Rigu'erwu Valley and attack Meinuo.
translations.idiomatic: They regrouped and advanced along the foothills of Rigu'erwu Valley against Meinuo.

sentences.zh: 上嘉國興功，官其子文虎守備。

translations.literal: The emperor praised Guo Xing's merit and appointed his son Wenhu as garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor commended Guo Xing's achievements and appointed his son Wenhu as garrison commander.

sentences.zh: 攻克布朗郭宗，僧格桑遁金川。

translations.literal: They captured Bulangguozong; Senggesang fled to Jinchuan.
translations.idiomatic: They took Bulangguozong, and Senggesang fled into Great Jinchuan.

sentences.zh: 我軍直抵底木達，僧格桑父澤旺出降。

translations.literal: Our army pressed straight to Dimuda; Senggesang's father Zewang came out to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Our forces pressed to Dimuda, where Senggesang's father Zewang surrendered.

sentences.zh: 小金川平。

translations.literal: Lesser Jinchuan was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Lesser Jinchuan was pacified.

sentences.zh: 國興卒於軍，賜白金千，存卹其家，加贈太子太保，諡壯武。

translations.literal: Guo Xing died in camp; he was granted a thousand taels of silver for funeral expenses and support of his family, posthumously promoted to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, with the posthumous epithet Zhuangwu (Stalwart and Martial).
translations.idiomatic: Guo Xing died in camp; the court granted a thousand taels of silver for his family, posthumously raised him to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and gave him the posthumous name Zhuangwu (Stalwart and Martial).

sentences.zh: 祀昭忠祠，圖形紫光閣。

translations.literal: He was enshrined in the Hall of Loyalty and Merit and his portrait placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: He was enshrined in the Hall of Loyalty and Merit, and his portrait was hung in the Hall of Purple Splendor.

sentences.zh: 文虎授陝西提標右營守備，從軍攻木果木，陣沒，從祀昭忠祠。

translations.literal: Wenhu was appointed garrison commander of the right battalion of the Shaanxi provincial command; he died in battle attacking Muguo Woods and was granted joint enshrinement in the Hall of Loyalty and Merit.
translations.idiomatic: Wenhu was made garrison commander of the Shaanxi provincial right battalion; he fell at Muguo Woods and was granted joint enshrinement in the Hall of Loyalty and Merit.

sentences.zh: 复官次子文彪千總。

translations.literal: His second son Wenbiao was also appointed a company commander of the thousand-man rank.
translations.idiomatic: His second son Wenbiao was also given an appointment as company commander.

sentences.zh: 任舉，山西大同人。

translations.literal: Ren Ju was a native of Datong in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Ju was from Datong in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 雍正二年武進士。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongzheng he passed the military metropolitan examination.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the military metropolitan examination in 1724.

sentences.zh: 以守備發陝西。

translations.literal: He was dispatched to Shaanxi as a garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: He was posted to Shaanxi as a garrison commander.

sentences.zh: 累遷固原提標左營游擊，署城守營參將。

translations.literal: He was promoted successively to battalion colonel of the left battalion of the Guyuan provincial command and acting garrison colonel of the city garrison.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to colonel of the Guyuan provincial left battalion and acting garrison colonel of the city command.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十一年十二月，固原兵變，夜攻提督許仕盛，毀轅門將入。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the eleventh year of Qianlong, Guyuan troops mutinied, attacking at night Provincial Military Commander Xu Shisheng, destroying the yamen gate and about to enter.
translations.idiomatic: In December 1746 the Guyuan garrison mutinied, attacked Provincial Commander Xu Shisheng by night, smashed the yamen gate, and were on the point of breaking in.

sentences.zh: 舉聞亂，單騎詣鼓樓鳴角，招營兵未變者才五十人，部勒使成列。

translations.literal: When Ju heard of the disturbance he rode alone to the drum tower and sounded the horn, summoning the fifty camp soldiers who had not mutinied and drilling them into formation.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing of the riot, Ju rode alone to the drum tower, sounded the horn, gathered the fifty men who had not joined the mutiny, and formed them into ranks.

sentences.zh: 變兵懼，退掠市廛。

translations.literal: The mutinous troops were afraid, withdrew, and plundered the market quarter.
translations.idiomatic: The mutineers lost heart, fell back, and looted the market streets.

sentences.zh: 舉追及，手刃十餘人，擒四十餘人。

translations.literal: Ju caught up with them, personally killed more than ten men, and captured more than forty.
translations.idiomatic: Ju overtook them, killed more than ten with his own hand, and took more than forty prisoner.

sentences.zh: 變兵出城南門，還攻東西二門。

translations.literal: The mutinous troops went out the south gate and returned to attack the east and west gates.
translations.idiomatic: The mutineers went out the south gate and turned back to assault the east and west gates.

sentences.zh: 舉守東門，右營游擊鐵保守西門，禦戰，變兵潰。

translations.literal: Ju defended the east gate; Right Battalion Colonel Tie Bao defended the west gate; they fought off the attack and the mutinous troops scattered.
translations.idiomatic: Ju held the east gate while Right Battalion Colonel Tie Bao held the west; they beat off the assault and the mutineers broke.

sentences.zh: 事定，總督慶復以聞，擢中軍參將。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled, Governor-General Qing Fu reported it and Ju was promoted to garrison colonel of the central battalion.
translations.idiomatic: When order was restored, Governor-General Qing Fu reported the affair and Ju was promoted to central-battalion colonel.

sentences.zh: 十二年，命徵金川，隸總督張廣泗軍。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was ordered on the Jinchuan campaign and placed under Governor-General Zhang Guangsi's army.
translations.idiomatic: In 1747 he was ordered to the Jinchuan campaign under Governor-General Zhang Guangsi.

sentences.zh: 尋授西鳳協副將。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed brigade deputy commander of the Xifeng garrison.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made deputy commander of the Xifeng garrison.

sentences.zh: 舉至軍，與總兵許應虎、副將高宗瑾、參將買國良攻色底賊碉，擊以砲二百餘發，碉一角圮，垣鑿孔發砲，密如鱗比。

translations.literal: When Ju reached the army, together with Regional Commander Xu Yinghu, Brigade Deputy Commander Gao Zongjin, and Garrison Colonel Mai Guoliang he attacked the rebel blockhouse at Sedi, firing more than two hundred cannon rounds; one corner of the blockhouse collapsed, and they bored holes in the wall to fire cannon as densely as fish scales.
translations.idiomatic: At the front Ju joined Regional Commander Xu Yinghu, Deputy Commander Gao Zongjin, and Colonel Mai Guoliang in assaulting the rebel blockhouse at Sedi; after more than two hundred rounds one corner gave way, and they bored holes in the wall to fire back until the embrasures were packed tight as scales.

sentences.zh: 舉度我軍砲小不能下，將移軍退守，賊出戰，再設伏敗之。

translations.literal: Ju judged that our army's cannon were too small to bring it down and was about to withdraw the army to hold defensive positions; the rebels came out to fight, and he set an ambush and defeated them again.
translations.idiomatic: Judging that Qing cannon were too light to breach the works, Ju was about to pull back to a defensive line when the rebels sallied; he laid another ambush and routed them.

sentences.zh: 十三年，上諭謂：「在軍諸將狃於瞻對之役，庸懦欺矇，已成夙習。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year the emperor instructed: "The generals in the army are habituated to the Zhandui campaign, being timid and deceitful, which has become a long-standing custom.
translations.idiomatic: In 1748 the emperor said, "The generals on this campaign are still mired in the habits of Zhandui—timid, deceitful conduct that has become second nature.

sentences.zh: 今別用舉等，皆未從征瞻對，無所掣肘，宜鼓勵勇往。

translations.literal: Now I am employing Ju and others separately; none of them served in the Zhandui campaign and thus have no constraints; they should be encouraged to advance boldly."
translations.idiomatic: I am now using Ju and men like him, none of whom served at Zhandui and none of whom are shackled by that record; they should be urged to press forward boldly."

sentences.zh: 」廣泗亦奏在川鎮將，忠誠勇幹無出舉右者，令率漢、土兵三千取道攻昔嶺。

translations.literal: Guangsi also memorialized that among the commanders in Sichuan, none surpassed Ju in loyalty, courage, and ability, and ordered him to lead three thousand Han and native troops by one route to attack Xiling.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Guangsi also reported that among Sichuan commanders none matched Ju in loyalty and martial ability, and ordered him to lead three thousand Han and native troops against Xiling.

sentences.zh: 尋又奏令署重慶鎮總兵。

translations.literal: Soon he again memorialized appointing him acting Chongqing regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: He soon memorialized again appointing Ju acting regional commander at Chongqing.

sentences.zh: 舉與參將王愷自牛廠至素可尼山。

translations.literal: Ju and Garrison Colonel Wang Kai went from Niuchang to Sukeni Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Ju and Colonel Wang Kai marched from Niuchang to Sukeni Mountain.

sentences.zh: 時五月，遇大雪，闢道以行。

translations.literal: It was the fifth month; they encountered heavy snow and opened a path to advance.
translations.idiomatic: It was the fifth month; they met deep snow and had to cut a road through it.

sentences.zh: 經撒烏山，至昔嶺山梁，山北曰木岡，孤峰當道，賊置城卡守隘。

translations.literal: They passed Sawo Mountain to the ridge of Xiling; north of the mountain was Mugang, a lone peak blocking the road where rebels had set up a walled barrier to guard the pass.
translations.idiomatic: They crossed Sawo Mountain to the Xiling ridge; to the north stood Mugang, a lone peak athwart the road where rebels had built a walled barrier.

sentences.zh: 舉督兵攻卡，憑高發砲洞其垣，令土兵緣溝潛進，毀賊碉。

translations.literal: Ju directed the troops to attack the barrier, fired cannon from the heights to breach its wall, and had native soldiers creep along the ravine to destroy the rebel blockhouses.
translations.idiomatic: Ju stormed the barrier, battered its wall with cannon from the heights, and sent native troops along the ravine to destroy the rebel blockhouses.

sentences.zh: 師循出山腰，克賊卡，遂陟中峰，以千人駐守，進攻木岡。

translations.literal: The army wound along the mountainside, captured the rebel barrier, then ascended the central peak, stationed a thousand men there, and advanced to attack Mugang.
translations.idiomatic: The column wound along the mountainside, took the barrier, seized the central peak with a thousand men, and pressed on against Mugang.

sentences.zh: 時總兵哈攀龍師至馬溝右梁，阻松林不得進。

translations.literal: At that time Regional Commander Ha Panlong's army had reached the right ridge of Magou but was blocked by the pine forest and could not advance.
translations.idiomatic: Regional Commander Ha Panlong had reached the right ridge of Magou but was held up in the pine woods.

sentences.zh: 廣泗令自納喇溝出昔嶺右，與舉合攻木岡賊所署城卡，力戰未即下。

translations.literal: Guangsi ordered him to come out from Nala Ravine to the right of Xiling and join Ju in attacking the walled barrier the Mugang rebels had set up; they fought hard but could not take it immediately.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Guangsi ordered Panlong out through Nala Ravine to Xiling's right to join Ju against the Mugang barrier; despite fierce fighting it did not fall at once.

sentences.zh: 舉察昔嶺左有道通卡撒，中經得思東、木達溝，賊皆置碉焉。

translations.literal: Ju saw that to the left of Xiling a road led to Kasa, passing through Desidong and Muda Ravine, where the rebels had all placed blockhouses.
translations.idiomatic: Ju found a road on Xiling's left to Kasa through Desidong and Muda Ravine, both lined with rebel blockhouses.

sentences.zh: 總兵冶​​大雄方自卡撒進，舉與合軍，焚木達溝諸碉，圍得思東，斷其汲道，督兵挾斧斫賊，賊墮岩遁，得大小碉三。

translations.literal: Regional Commander Ye Daxiong was advancing from Kasa; Ju joined his army, burned the blockhouses in Muda Ravine, besieged Desidong, cut off their water supply, directed troops with axes to hack at the rebels; the rebels fell from the cliffs and fled, and they obtained three large and small blockhouses.
translations.idiomatic: Regional Commander Ye Daxiong was advancing from Kasa; Ju joined him, burned the Muda Ravine blockhouses, besieged Desidong and cut its water, and drove the rebels over the cliffs with axmen—taking three blockhouses in all.

sentences.zh: 進攻色爾力石城，分兵為三道：舉督兵直攻石城，攀龍出其右，副將唐開中及國良出其左。

translations.literal: Advancing to attack the Serli stone fortress, they divided into three columns: Ju directed troops straight at the stone fortress, Panlong on the right, and Brigade Deputy Commander Tang Kaizhong and Guoliang on the left.
translations.idiomatic: In the assault on the Serli stone fortress they split three ways: Ju struck the fortress head-on, Panlong on the right, and Deputy Commander Tang Kaizhong and Guoliang on the left.

sentences.zh: 越溝度林，攻賊所置木城，國良戰死。

translations.literal: Crossing ravines and passing through forest, they attacked the wooden fortress the rebels had built; Guoliang died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Crossing ravines and woods they stormed the rebels' wooden fort; Guoliang was killed in action.

sentences.zh: 六月己巳，舉與攀龍、開中合攻石城，城堅甚。

translations.literal: On the sixth month day jisi, Ju joined Panlong and Kaizhong in a combined attack on the stone fortress; the fortress was extremely strong.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day of the sixth month Ju, Panlong, and Kaizhong attacked the stone fortress together; it was exceedingly strong.

sentences.zh: 我師方力攻，賊三百餘自西南林內出，舉督兵與戰，被創；

translations.literal: As our army was pressing the attack, more than three hundred rebels emerged from the southwest forest; Ju directed the troops to fight and was wounded;
translations.idiomatic: While the assault was at its height more than three hundred rebels burst from the southwest woods; Ju led the fight and was wounded;

sentences.zh: 戰益力，槍復中要害，遂卒。

translations.literal: he fought with increasing intensity; a musket shot struck a vital spot and he died.
translations.idiomatic: he fought on harder still until a musket ball found a vital spot and he fell dead.

sentences.zh: 攀龍入林殺賊，以其屍還。

translations.literal: Panlong entered the forest and killed rebels, bringing back Ju's body.
translations.idiomatic: Panlong fought into the woods, killed rebels, and brought Ju's body back.

sentences.zh: 時上方命舉真除，經略大學士訥親以舉死事聞，上閱疏為泣下，並諭：「舉忠憤激發，甘死如飴，而朕以小丑跳梁，用良臣於危地，思之深惻！

translations.literal: The emperor had just ordered Ju's regular appointment when Commissioner Grand Secretary Neqin reported Ju's death in service; the emperor wept on reading the memorial and also instructed: "Ju was stirred by loyal indignation and welcomed death as sweet, yet I used a worthy minister in a dangerous place over these petty rebels leaping about—thinking of it cuts deeply to the heart!"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had just confirmed Ju's appointment when Grand Secretary Neqin reported his death in battle; reading the memorial the emperor wept and said, "Ju met death gladly out of loyal rage, yet I sent a fine officer into peril over these petty rebels—the thought pierces me to the heart!"

sentences.zh: 」命視提督例賜卹，加都督同知，諡勇烈，祀昭忠祠，官其子承恩都司，承緒千總。

translations.literal: He was ordered funerary grants according to the provincial commander precedent, posthumously promoted to Vice Commissioner-in-Chief, given the posthumous epithet Yonglie, enshrined in the Hall of Loyalty and Merit, and his sons Chengen and Chenxu were appointed respectively company commander and thousand-man commander.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted funeral honors on the provincial-commander scale, posthumously raised to Vice Commissioner-in-Chief, given the posthumous name Yonglie, enshrined in the Hall of Loyalty and Merit, and his sons Chengen and Chenxu were made company commander and thousand-man commander.

sentences.zh: 承恩喪終入謝，上以尚幼，命傳諭其母善教之。

translations.literal: When Chengen came to court after mourning to give thanks, the emperor said he was still young and ordered a message conveyed to his mother to rear him well.
translations.idiomatic: When Chengen came to court after mourning, the emperor said he was still young and told his mother through an envoy to raise him carefully.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，授三等侍衛。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he was appointed Third-Class Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In 1759 he was appointed Third-Class Bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 累遷福建陸路提督。

translations.literal: He was promoted successively to provincial military commander of Fujian on land.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to provincial commander of Fujian on land.

sentences.zh: 五十二年，台灣林爽文為亂，承恩請往討之，師無功，逮詣京師，罪當死，上寬之。

translations.literal: In the fifty-second year Lin Shuangwen rebelled in Taiwan; Chengen asked to go suppress him but the army achieved no success; brought to the capital he deserved death but the emperor spared him.
translations.idiomatic: In 1787 Lin Shuangwen rebelled in Taiwan; Chengen volunteered to suppress him, but the campaign failed; brought to Beijing he deserved death, yet the emperor spared him.

sentences.zh: 五十三年，赦出獄。

translations.literal: In the fifty-third year he was pardoned and released from prison.
translations.idiomatic: In 1788 he was pardoned and released from prison.

sentences.zh: 五十五年，复授巡捕營參將，遷副將。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fifth year he was again appointed garrison colonel of the patrol battalion and transferred to brigade deputy commander.
translations.idiomatic: In 1790 he was again made patrol-battalion colonel and then deputy commander.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 承緒官巡捕營游擊，市中火，赴救被創，卒。

translations.literal: Chenxu served as battalion colonel of the patrol battalion; when fire broke out in the market he went to rescue and was wounded, then died.
translations.idiomatic: Chenxu was patrol-battalion colonel; when fire broke out in the market he rushed to help, was wounded, and died.

sentences.zh: 上之赦承恩，謂其未有子，承緒又死勤事，不可使舉無嗣也。

translations.literal: When the emperor pardoned Chengen he said Chengen had no son and Chenxu had also died in diligent service—it could not be that Ju had no heir.
translations.idiomatic: In pardoning Chengen the emperor said he had no son and Chenxu had died in the line of duty—Ju's line could not be allowed to end.

sentences.zh: 冶大雄，四川成都人。

translations.literal: Ye Daxiong was a native of Chengdu in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Ye Daxiong was from Chengdu in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 康熙季年入伍，從征西藏，克里塘、巴塘，降結敦落籠宗、說板多打籠宗諸寨，獲為亂喇嘛五。

translations.literal: In the last years of Kangxi he entered the ranks and joined the Tibet campaign at Keri and Batang, reducing Jiedun, Luolongzong, Shuoban, Duodalongzong stockades and capturing five rebellious lamas.
translations.idiomatic: In the late Kangxi era he enlisted and campaigned in Tibet at Keri and Batang, reducing several stockades and capturing five rebellious lamas.

sentences.zh: 雍正初，從軍出松潘黃勝關，剿撫熱當十二部落。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yongzheng he joined the army out of Songpan Huangsheng Pass and pacified the twelve Redang tribes.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Yongzheng reign he marched from Songpan through Huangsheng Pass and pacified the twelve Redang tribes.

sentences.zh: 攻郭隆寺，攻嶺三，破寨十五，追斬康布喇嘛於西海。

translations.literal: Attacking Guolong Monastery, he assaulted three ridges, broke fifteen stockades, and pursued and killed the Kangbu lama at Qinghai.
translations.idiomatic: At Guolong Monastery he took three ridges and fifteen stockades and pursued the Kangbu lama to Qinghai, where he was killed.

sentences.zh: 又從征桌子山、棋子山，戮頭人。

translations.literal: He also joined campaigns at Zhuozi Mountain and Qizi Mountain and killed tribal leaders.
translations.idiomatic: He also fought at Zhuozi and Qizi mountains and killed tribal chiefs.

sentences.zh: 追剿羅卜藏丹津，擒丹津琿台吉。

translations.literal: Pursuing Lobzang Danjin he captured Danjin Huitaiji.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuing Lobzang Danjin he captured Danjin Huitaiji.

sentences.zh: 川陝總督岳鍾琪疏薦，引見，特授藍翎侍衛。

translations.literal: Sichuan-Shaanxi Governor-General Yue Zhongqi memorialized recommending him; he was received in audience and specially appointed Blue-Lapel Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Yue Zhongqi recommended him; received at court, he was specially made a Blue-Lapel Bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 累遷陝西莊浪營參將。

translations.literal: He was promoted successively to garrison colonel of the Zhuanglang garrison in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to garrison colonel at Zhuanglang in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 加副將銜，賜孔雀翎，命赴巴里坤軍，檄署川陝標中軍副將。

translations.literal: Given brigade deputy rank and the peacock feather, he was ordered to the Balikun army and by dispatch appointed acting brigade deputy of the central column of the Sichuan-Shaanxi command.
translations.idiomatic: Given deputy-commander rank and the peacock feather, he was sent to the Balikun army and by dispatch made acting deputy commander of the Sichuan-Shaanxi central column.

sentences.zh: 準噶爾犯克什圖、峨崙磯諸卡倫。

translations.literal: The Dzungars attacked the Kashi and Ekunji frontier barriers.
translations.idiomatic: The Dzungars attacked the frontier barriers at Kashi and Ekunji.

sentences.zh: 大雄偕總兵樊廷以​​二千人當賊二萬，轉戰七晝夜，拔守卡倫兵以出。

translations.literal: Daxiong together with Regional Commander Fan Yan with two thousand men faced twenty thousand rebels, fought for seven days and nights, and rescued the soldiers defending the barriers.
translations.idiomatic: With Regional Commander Fan Yan, Daxiong held twenty thousand rebels at bay with two thousand men for seven days and nights and brought the garrison out of the besieged barriers.

sentences.zh: 與總兵張元佐等師會，力戰殺賊。

translations.literal: Joining forces with Regional Commander Zhang Yuanzuo and others they fought hard and killed many rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Joining Zhang Yuanzuo and others, they fought fiercely and killed many of the enemy.

sentences.zh: 賜拜他喇布勒哈番世職，賚白金五千。

translations.literal: He was granted the hereditary rank of Baitalabulehafan and bestowed five thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted the hereditary rank of Baitalabulehafan and five thousand taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 尋授直隸山永協副將。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed brigade deputy commander of the Shanyong garrison in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made deputy commander of the Shanyong garrison in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 命署湖北彝陵鎮總兵。

translations.literal: He was ordered acting regional commander of the Yiling garrison in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed acting regional commander at Yiling in Hubei.

sentences.zh: 上言：「彝陵距省千餘裡，兵餉歲以四季支給，請改夏秋、冬春二次匯支。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "Yiling is more than a thousand li from the provincial capital; provisions for the troops are disbursed quarterly each year—please change to two disbursements in summer-autumn and winter-spring."
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized, "Yiling lies more than a thousand li from the provincial capital; troop pay is issued quarterly—please change to two disbursements, in summer-autumn and winter-spring."

sentences.zh: 」下督撫議行。

translations.literal: This was referred to the governor-general and provincial governor for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was sent to the governor-general and governor for approval and implementation.

sentences.zh: 尋調署山西大同鎮總兵。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to acting regional commander of the Datong garrison in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to acting regional commander at Datong in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 與前任總兵李如栢互劾，均奪職。

translations.literal: He and former regional commander Li Rubai accused each other; both were stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: He and the former commander Li Rubai accused each other; both were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，以副將發湖廣，尋授衡州協副將。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong he was dispatched to Huguang as brigade deputy and soon appointed brigade deputy of the Hengzhou garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In 1736 he was posted to Huguang as a deputy commander and soon made deputy commander at Hengzhou.

sentences.zh: 城綏苗、瑤為亂，大雄駐長安堡，焚賊寨，戮其渠，餘相率就撫。

translations.literal: The Chengsui Miao and Yao rebelled; Daxiong garrisoned Chang'an Fort, burned rebel stockades, executed their chiefs, and the rest submitted in succession.
translations.idiomatic: When the Chengsui Miao and Yao rebelled, Daxiong garrisoned Chang'an Fort, burned rebel stockades, executed the ringleaders, and the rest submitted.

sentences.zh: 擢鎮筸鎮總兵。

translations.literal: He was promoted to regional commander of the Zhenjiang garrison.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to regional commander at Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 總督孫嘉淦劾大雄貪縱，奪職。

translations.literal: Governor-General Sun Jiagan accused Daxiong of greed and indulgence; his office was taken.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Sun Jiagan accused him of greed and lax discipline, and he was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 湖南巡撫蔣溥言讞無貪縱跡，引見，复授雲南昭通鎮總兵。

translations.literal: Hunan Governor Jiang Pu said the judgment found no evidence of greed or indulgence; received in audience he was again appointed regional commander of the Zhaotong garrison in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan Governor Jiang Pu reported that the case showed no proof of greed or indulgence; received at court, he was again made regional commander at Zhaotong in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 敘剿苗功，加都督僉事銜。

translations.literal: For merit in suppressing the Miao he was given the rank of Assistant Commissioner-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: For suppressing the Miao he was given the rank of Assistant Commissioner-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 十三年，從征金川，至卡撒，統雲南、貴州諸軍進攻色底、光多諸寨。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he joined the Jinchuan campaign, reached Kasa, and commanded the Yunnan and Guizhou armies in attacking Sedi, Guangduo, and other stockades.
translations.idiomatic: In 1748 he joined the Jinchuan campaign, reached Kasa, and led the Yunnan and Guizhou forces against Sedi, Guangduo, and other stockades.

sentences.zh: 引兵出昔嶺中峰之西，與署總兵哈攀龍、任舉師會，克大小碉十、石城一，墮碉百三十。

translations.literal: Leading troops west of the central peak of Xiling he joined Acting Regional Commander Ha Panlong and Ren Ju's armies and captured ten large and small blockhouses and one stone fortress, destroying one hundred thirty blockhouses.
translations.idiomatic: He led troops west of Xiling's central peak, joined Ha Panlong and Ren Ju, took ten blockhouses and one stone fortress, and destroyed one hundred thirty more.

sentences.zh: 同攻克昔嶺溝底石城水卡。

translations.literal: Together they captured the stone fortress water barrier at the bottom of Xiling Ravine.
translations.idiomatic: Together they captured the stone fortress and water barrier at the foot of Xiling Ravine.

sentences.zh: 經略大學士傅恆奏大雄歷經戰陣，令總理營壘，措置妥協，賜孔雀翎。

translations.literal: Commissioner Grand Secretary Fu Heng memorialized that Daxiong had passed through many battles and ordered him to oversee camps in all arrangements properly; he was granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Fu Heng reported Daxiong's long combat experience and put him in charge of camp arrangements; he was granted the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 金川頭人莎羅奔等乞降，師還。

translations.literal: Jinchuan chieftains including Saloben begged to surrender; the army returned.
translations.idiomatic: The Jinchuan chieftains including Saloben sued for peace and the army withdrew.

sentences.zh: 授雲南提督，加左都督銜。

translations.literal: He was appointed provincial commander of Yunnan with the rank of Left Assistant Commissioner-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was made provincial commander of Yunnan with the rank of Left Assistant Commissioner-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 入覲，官其子繼鈞藍翎侍衛，命送大雄上官。

translations.literal: On imperial audience his son Jijun was appointed Blue-Lapel Bodyguard and ordered to escort Daxiong to his post.
translations.idiomatic: At court his son Jijun was made Blue-Lapel Bodyguard and ordered to escort Daxiong to his post.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「西藏喀拉烏蘇諸地與準噶爾連界，盜竊紛擾，是其故習。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "The places Kalawusu and others in Tibet border on the Dzungars; theft and disturbance are their customary practices.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized, "Places such as Kalawusu in Tibet border the Dzungars, and banditry there is an old habit.

sentences.zh: 今藏北鄙即我邊地，防邊自可弭盜。

translations.literal: Now Tibet's northern marches are our borderland; defending the frontier can itself suppress banditry.
translations.idiomatic: Now Tibet's northern frontier is our border; guarding it will itself suppress banditry.

sentences.zh: 請駐藏大臣仍設重兵，循大道置台站，以資防守。

translations.literal: Please have the resident commissioner in Tibet continue to station heavy troops and set stations along the main road for defense."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the resident commissioner keep strong garrisons and post stations along the main road for defense."

sentences.zh: 」上嘉其留心。

translations.literal: The emperor commended his attentiveness.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his attentiveness.

sentences.zh: 繼鈞至常德迎家，中途假回民金，大雄以聞。

translations.literal: Jijun met the family at Changde en route; on the way he borrowed money from a Hui merchant and Daxiong reported it.
translations.idiomatic: Jijun met the family at Changde; en route he borrowed money from a Hui merchant, and Daxiong reported it.

sentences.zh: 上以大雄知事不可揜乃始奏劾，左授哈密總兵。

translations.literal: The emperor said Daxiong had known the matter could not be concealed and only then memorialized; he was demoted to regional commander of Hami.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said Daxiong had waited until exposure was inevitable before reporting it; he was demoted to regional commander at Hami.

sentences.zh: 命署安西提督，赴巴里坤驗馬駝，疏報四千餘。

translations.literal: He was ordered acting provincial commander of Anxi and sent to Balikun to inspect horses and camels, reporting more than four thousand.
translations.idiomatic: He was made acting provincial commander of Anxi and sent to Balikun to inspect horses and camels, reporting more than four thousand.

sentences.zh: 會總督方觀承核參將鍾世傑等至巴里坤領馬千九百餘，途中馬多死，論罪。

translations.literal: When Governor-General Fang Guancheng verified Battalion Colonel Zhong Shijie and others at Balikun received nineteen hundred-odd horses, many died on the road and they were punished.
translations.idiomatic: When Governor-General Fang Guancheng verified that Colonel Zhong Shijie and others received only nineteen hundred-odd horses at Balikun and many died en route, they were punished.

sentences.zh: 上以大雄疏不實，下部議；

translations.literal: The emperor said Daxiong's memorial was untrue and referred it to the ministry for deliberation;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor found Daxiong's report false and referred the case to the ministry;

sentences.zh: 總督黃廷桂复劾大雄，命奪官，逮京師治罪。

translations.literal: Governor-General Huang Tinggui again accused Daxiong; he was ordered stripped of office and brought to the capital for punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Huang Tinggui accused him again; he was stripped of office and brought to Beijing for trial.

sentences.zh: 二十一年四月，行至西安，卒。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year fourth month he died on reaching Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of 1756 he died on reaching Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，上以綠營世職不得世襲罔替，下兵部察諸將有功者，俟襲次畢，賜恩騎尉世襲罔替，大雄與焉。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year the emperor said Green Standard hereditary offices could not be perpetual and ordered the Ministry of War to examine meritorious generals; when their succession quota was filled they would be granted Ensign hereditary perpetual rank—and Daxiong was among them.
translations.idiomatic: In 1767 the emperor noted that Green Standard hereditary posts could not pass in perpetuity and ordered the Ministry of War to review meritorious officers; when succession quotas were filled they would receive perpetual Ensign rank—and Daxiong was included.

sentences.zh: 馬良柱，甘肅張掖人，其先本回部。

translations.literal: Ma Liangzhu was a native of Zhangye in Gansu; his ancestors were originally from the Hui communities.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Liangzhu was from Zhangye in Gansu; his family originally came from the Muslim communities.

sentences.zh: 康熙季年，從軍徵吐魯蕃；

translations.literal: In the last years of Kangxi he joined the army in the campaign against Turfan;
translations.idiomatic: In the late Kangxi era he campaigned against Turfan;

sentences.zh: 雍正初，將軍阿爾邦檄赴插漢麥里幹討賊：皆有功。

translations.literal: at the beginning of Yongzheng General Alabang ordered him to Chaohanmailigan to suppress rebels: in both he had merit.
translations.idiomatic: and early in Yongzheng General Alabang sent him to Chaohanmailigan to suppress rebels—in each campaign he distinguished himself.

sentences.zh: 復從安西鎮總兵孫繼宗攻羅卜藏丹津，降台吉三十三。

translations.literal: He again followed Anxi Regional Commander Sun Jizong in attacking Lobzang Danjin and received the surrender of thirty-three taiji.
translations.idiomatic: He again followed Anxi Commander Sun Jizong against Lobzang Danjin and received the surrender of thirty-three taiji.

sentences.zh: 戰於哈馬兒打布罕噶斯，擒其渠，授藍翎侍衛，賜白金百，遷三等侍衛。

translations.literal: Fighting at Hamar'dabuhangasi he captured their chief, was appointed Blue-Lapel Bodyguard, granted a hundred taels of silver, and promoted to Third-Class Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: At Hamar'dabuhangasi he captured the rebel chief, was made Blue-Lapel Bodyguard, granted a hundred taels of silver, and promoted to Third-Class Bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 外授四川提標游擊，賜貂皮、數珠。

translations.literal: He was sent out as battalion colonel of the Sichuan provincial command and granted sable fur and prayer beads.
translations.idiomatic: He was posted to Sichuan as provincial battalion colonel and granted sable fur and prayer beads.

sentences.zh: 命將兵屯西藏。

translations.literal: He was ordered to lead troops garrisoned in Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to garrison troops in Tibet.

sentences.zh: 旋以兵擾民，左降，聽四川巡撫、提督調遣。

translations.literal: Soon for troops harassing the people he was demoted and placed under the dispatch of the Sichuan governor and provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: Soon his troops were found harassing civilians; he was demoted and placed under the Sichuan governor and provincial commander.

sentences.zh: 八年，瞻對土司為亂，提督黃廷桂檄良柱討之。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the Zhandui native chieftain rebelled; Provincial Commander Huang Tinggui ordered Liangzhu to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: In 1730 the Zhandui chieftain rebelled; Provincial Commander Huang Tinggui ordered Liangzhu to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 賊堅守石碉，督兵仰攻，槍殪所乘馬，易馬進，再殪，乃步行督戰。

translations.literal: The rebels held firm in stone blockhouses; he directed troops in uphill assault; musket fire killed the horse he rode; changing horses he advanced again and was killed again, then walked on foot to direct the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels held stone blockhouses; he led uphill assaults; musket fire killed his horse twice, and he walked on foot to direct the fighting.

sentences.zh: 碉上投石如雨，傷面，搏賊益奮，火其碉，並焚擦馬、擦牙諸寨，殲賊無算。

translations.literal: Stones rained from the blockhouses injuring his face; he fought the rebels with increasing fury, set fire to the blockhouses, and also burned the Camar and Caya stockades, destroying countless rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Stones rained down and wounded his face; he fought on with greater fury, burned the blockhouses, and also burned the Camar and Caya stockades, destroying countless rebels.

sentences.zh: 側冷邦諸頭人皆降。

translations.literal: The chieftains of Cilenbang all submitted.
translations.idiomatic: The chieftains of Cilenbang all submitted.

sentences.zh: 复授松潘鎮左營游擊。

translations.literal: He was again appointed battalion colonel of the left battalion of the Songpan garrison.
translations.idiomatic: He was again made left-battalion colonel of the Songpan garrison.

sentences.zh: 三遷夔州協副將。

translations.literal: He was transferred three times to brigade deputy of the Kuizhou garrison.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred three times to deputy commander at Kuizhou.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十年，師复徵瞻對，破直達、鬆多諸寨，奪碉七十餘。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Qianlong the army again campaigned against Zhandui, breaking Zhida and Songduo stockades and seizing more than seventy blockhouses.
translations.idiomatic: In 1745 the army campaigned again against Zhandui, breaking Zhida and Songduo stockades and taking more than seventy blockhouses.

sentences.zh: 進攻下密左山梁，獲頭人噶籠丹坪。

translations.literal: Advancing to attack the ridge of Xiamizuo Mountain they captured the chieftain Galong Danping.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing on the Xiamizuo ridge they captured chieftain Galong Danping.

sentences.zh: 再進克下密等百餘寨，獲頭人塔巴四交。

translations.literal: Advancing again they captured more than a hundred stockades including Xiami and captured chieftain Taba Sijiao.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing forward they took more than a hundred stockades including Xiami and captured chieftain Taba Sijiao.

sentences.zh: 渡丫魯河，遂破瞻對，焚其寨。

translations.literal: Crossing the Yalu River they then broke Zhandui and burned its stockades.
translations.idiomatic: Crossing the Yalu River they broke Zhandui and burned its stockades.

sentences.zh: 其渠姜錯太死於火。

translations.literal: Their chieftain Jiangcuotai died in the fire.
translations.idiomatic: Their chieftain Jiangcuotai died in the flames.

sentences.zh: 十二年，大金川酋莎羅奔攻革布什咱土司，並掠明正土司所屬魯密、章谷諸地。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year Great Jinchuan chieftain Saloben attacked the Gebushizan native chieftain and also plundered Lumu, Zhanggu, and other territories belonging to the Mingzheng native chieftain.
translations.idiomatic: In 1747 Great Jinchuan chief Saloben attacked the Gebushizan chieftain and raided Lumu, Zhanggu, and other lands of the Mingzheng chieftain.

sentences.zh: 巡撫紀山移良柱威茂協副將，督兵防禦。

translations.literal: Governor Ji Shan transferred Liangzhu from Weimao garrison deputy to supervise troops in defense.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Ji Shan moved Liangzhu from Weimao to deputy commander and put him in charge of the defense.

sentences.zh: 莎羅奔糾小金川土司澤旺侵沃日各寨，都司馬光祖赴援，賊大至，光祖困於熱籠。

translations.literal: Saloben enlisted Lesser Jinchuan chieftain Zewang to invade the Wo Day stockades; Major Ma Guangzu went to reinforce and the rebels came in great numbers; Guangzu was trapped at Relong.
translations.idiomatic: Saloben enlisted Lesser Jinchuan chief Zewang to invade the Wo Day stockades; Major Ma Guangzu went to reinforce but was surrounded at Relong when the rebels came in force.

sentences.zh: 良柱率輕騎馳救，敗賊巴納山，進克石卡二百二十三。

translations.literal: Liangzhu led light cavalry to the rescue, defeated the rebels at Bana Mountain, and advanced to capture two hundred twenty-three stone barriers.
translations.idiomatic: Liangzhu led light cavalry to the rescue, routed the rebels at Bana Mountain, and took two hundred twenty-three stone barriers.

sentences.zh: 光祖等出應，賊潰，圍解。

translations.literal: Guangzu and others came out to respond; the rebels scattered and the siege was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Guangzu and others sallied forth; the rebels broke and the siege was lifted.

sentences.zh: 澤旺降，並還所侵沃日三寨。

translations.literal: Zewang surrendered and also returned the three Wo Day stockades he had seized.
translations.idiomatic: Zewang surrendered and returned the three Wo Day stockades he had seized.

sentences.zh: 詔嘉其奮勇，遷重慶鎮總兵。

translations.literal: An edict praised his valor and he was transferred to regional commander of the Chongqing garrison.
translations.idiomatic: The court commended his valor and made him regional commander at Chongqing.

sentences.zh: 再進复孫克宗官寨，攻江卡，戰屢勝，克大小碉寨百餘，降二十餘寨。

translations.literal: Advancing again he recovered the Sunkezong official stockade, attacked Jiangka, won repeated battles, captured more than a hundred large and small blockhouses and stockades, and received the surrender of more than twenty stockades.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced again, retook Sunkezong, attacked Jiangka, won battle after battle, took more than a hundred blockhouses and stockades, and received the surrender of more than twenty strongholds.

sentences.zh: 進克丹噶山，分兵焚撒籠等七寨，噶固等寨先後降。

translations.literal: He advanced to capture Danga Mountain, divided his forces to burn seven stockades including Salong, and the stockades at Gagu and elsewhere submitted in succession.
translations.idiomatic: He took Danga Mountain, detached troops to burn seven stockades including Salong, and the Gagu stockades submitted one after another.

sentences.zh: 賊守石達大碉，良柱冒雨進，數十戰，賊乘夜來撲營，設伏，殲焉。

translations.literal: The rebels held the great blockhouse at Shida; Liangzhu advanced in the rain through dozens of battles; the rebels came by night to storm the camp; he set an ambush and destroyed them.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels held the great blockhouse at Shida; Liangzhu pressed forward in the rain through dozens of fights; when rebels stormed the camp by night he ambushed and destroyed them.

sentences.zh: 馬邦頭人思錯已降，總兵許應虎馭之不以道，复叛，圍應虎於的交，良柱馳救。

translations.literal: The Mabang chieftain Sicuo had already submitted; Regional Commander Xu Yinghu treated him improperly and he rebelled again, besieging Yinghu at Dijiao; Liangzhu galloped to the rescue.
translations.idiomatic: Mabang chieftain Sicuo had submitted, but Regional Commander Xu Yinghu mishandled him and he rebelled again, besieging Yinghu at Dijiao; Liangzhu rode to the rescue.

sentences.zh: 賊退入戎布寨，攻之未下。

translations.literal: The rebels retreated into the Rongbu stockade; the attack did not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fell back into Rongbu stockade, which could not be taken.

sentences.zh: 旋复犯馬邦，副將張興被圍。

translations.literal: Soon they again invaded Mabang and Brigade Deputy Commander Zhang Xing was surrounded.
translations.idiomatic: Soon they raided Mabang again and Deputy Commander Zhang Xing was surrounded.

sentences.zh: 良柱請移戎布師赴援，總督張廣泗不許，興陷於賊。

translations.literal: Liangzhu asked to move the Rongbu force to reinforce; Governor-General Zhang Guangsi did not permit it, and Xing fell into rebel hands.
translations.idiomatic: Liangzhu asked to shift the Rongbu column to reinforce Zhang Xing, but Zhang Guangsi refused, and Xing was lost to the rebels.

sentences.zh: 侵噶固，守兵叛附賊，奪卡倫七。

translations.literal: Invading Gagu, the garrison troops mutinied and joined the rebels, seizing seven frontier barriers.
translations.idiomatic: At Gagu the garrison mutinied to the rebels' side and seven frontier barriers were lost.

sentences.zh: 廣泗令良柱往攻，力戰，賊未卻。

translations.literal: Guangsi ordered Liangzhu to attack; they fought hard but the rebels did not retreat.
translations.idiomatic: Guangsi ordered Liangzhu to attack; despite fierce fighting the rebels held.

sentences.zh: 值大雪二十餘日，糧匱，煮鎧弩以食。

translations.literal: Heavy snow fell for more than twenty days; provisions ran out and they boiled armor and crossbows for food.
translations.idiomatic: Snow fell for more than twenty days; provisions ran out and they boiled armor and crossbow parts for food.

sentences.zh: 力不支，廣泗檄退師。

translations.literal: Unable to hold out, Guangsi ordered withdrawal by dispatch.
translations.idiomatic: Unable to hold on, Guangsi ordered a withdrawal.

sentences.zh: 倉卒移營，砲械為賊得。

translations.literal: In a hasty move of camp, cannon and weapons were taken by the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In the hasty withdrawal, cannon and arms fell into rebel hands.

sentences.zh: 廣泗劾之，命逮詣京師，良柱陳糧絕狀，上特原之。

translations.literal: Guangsi memorialized against him and ordered him brought to the capital; Liangzhu stated the condition of exhausted provisions and the emperor specially pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: Guangsi accused him and ordered him to Beijing; Liangzhu explained that provisions had run out, and the emperor specially pardoned him.

sentences.zh: 命在香山教禁軍雲梯，親臨觀之。

translations.literal: He was ordered to teach scaling ladders to the Forbidden Army at Xiangshan, and the emperor personally came to observe.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to train the Forbidden Army in siege ladders at Xiangshan, and the emperor came in person to watch.

sentences.zh: 良柱起舞鞭，稱旨，賜大緞、荷包。

translations.literal: Liangzhu danced with his iron whip to the emperor's pleasure and was granted fine silk and a reward purse.
translations.idiomatic: Liangzhu performed a whip dance that pleased the emperor, who granted him fine silk and a reward purse.

sentences.zh: 命仍赴金川軍，以副將、參將等官酌量委用。

translations.literal: He was ordered to return to the Jinchuan army and appointed at discretion to posts as brigade deputy, garrison colonel, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent back to the Jinchuan army and given appropriate posts as deputy commander or colonel.

sentences.zh: 尋授泰宁協副將，大學士傅恆視師，檄良柱攻昔嶺，克之。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed brigade deputy of the Taining garrison; Grand Secretary Fu Heng took command of the army and by dispatch ordered Liangzhu to attack Xiling; he captured it.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made deputy commander at Taining; Grand Secretary Fu Heng took the field and ordered Liangzhu to take Xiling, which he did.

sentences.zh: 莎羅奔請降，良柱以十餘騎入其營宣諭。

translations.literal: Saloben begged to surrender; Liangzhu entered his camp with a dozen-odd horsemen to proclaim the imperial will.
translations.idiomatic: When Saloben sued for peace, Liangzhu rode into his camp with a dozen men to proclaim the imperial terms.

sentences.zh: 授建昌鎮總兵，賜孔雀翎。

translations.literal: He was appointed regional commander of the Jianchang garrison and granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: He was made regional commander at Jianchang and granted the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 母憂去官。

translations.literal: He left office on account of his mother's death.
translations.idiomatic: He left office to mourn his mother.

sentences.zh: 召入京師，仍令教禁軍習雲梯。

translations.literal: Summoned to the capital, he was again ordered to teach the Forbidden Army scaling ladders.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned to Beijing, he was again ordered to train the Forbidden Army in siege ladders.

sentences.zh: 服闋，授松潘鎮總兵。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he was appointed regional commander of the Songpan garrison.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended he was made regional commander at Songpan.

sentences.zh: 雜穀土司蒼旺為亂，偕提​​督岳鍾琪討平之。

translations.literal: The Zagu native chieftain Cangwang rebelled; together with Provincial Commander Yue Zhongqi he suppressed and pacified him.
translations.idiomatic: When the Zagu chieftain Cangwang rebelled, he joined Provincial Commander Yue Zhongqi in suppressing him.

sentences.zh: 尋請老，改籍四川華陽。

translations.literal: Soon he requested retirement and changed his household register to Huayang in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: He soon asked to retire and registered his household at Huayang in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 卒，年八十一。

translations.literal: He died at the age of eighty-one.
translations.idiomatic: He died at the age of eighty-one.

sentences.zh: 良柱額然，大目虯髯，邊人畏之，號為獅子頭。

translations.literal: Liangzhu had a broad forehead, large eyes, and curly beard; border people feared him and called him Lion's Head.
translations.idiomatic: Liangzhu had a broad brow, large eyes, and a curling beard; frontier people feared him and called him Lion's Head.

sentences.zh: 善戰，臨陣手鐵鞭一，馬上旋轉如飛。

translations.literal: Skilled in battle, in action he wielded a single iron whip, whirling it on horseback like flying.
translations.idiomatic: A skilled fighter, in battle he wielded an iron whip that he spun on horseback like a wheel.

sentences.zh: 其攻噶固，廣泗不為策應，餉又不時至，上知廣泗忌其成功，故特輕其罰雲。

translations.literal: In his attack on Gagu, Guangsi gave no coordinated support and pay did not arrive on time; the emperor knew Guangsi resented his success, and therefore specially lightened his punishment.
translations.idiomatic: At Gagu, Guangsi gave no support and pay arrived late; the emperor knew Guangsi resented his success, and therefore lightened his punishment.

sentences.zh: 子應詔，官直隸河間副將。

translations.literal: His son Yingzhao served as brigade deputy of Hejian in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yingzhao was deputy commander at Hejian in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 孫瑜，自有傳。

translations.literal: His grandson Yu has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: His grandson Yu has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 本進忠，甘肅西寧人。

translations.literal: Ben Jinzhong was a native of Xining in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Ben Jinzhong was from Xining in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 初入伍，冒姓名曰張元吉，尋請復姓名。

translations.literal: When he first entered the ranks he used the false name Zhang Yuanji and soon requested restoration of his true name.
translations.idiomatic: When he enlisted he used the alias Zhang Yuanji and soon asked to restore his true name.

sentences.zh: 雍正中，從揚武將軍張廣泗援吐魯番，屯魯克沁。

translations.literal: During Yongzheng he followed General Zhang Guangsi in relief of Turfan and garrisoned Lukqin.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yongzheng era he followed General Zhang Guangsi to relieve Turfan and garrisoned Lukqin.

sentences.zh: 準噶爾來侵，邀擊，擒賊七。

translations.literal: When the Dzungars invaded he intercepted them and captured seven rebels.
translations.idiomatic: When the Dzungars attacked he intercepted them and took seven prisoners.

sentences.zh: 复追敗之哈喇和卓。

translations.literal: Again he pursued and defeated them at Halahezhuo.
translations.idiomatic: He pursued them again and defeated them at Halahezhuo.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十三年，檄赴金川，從征囊得山梁。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Qianlong he was ordered by dispatch to Jinchuan and joined the campaign at Nangde Mountain Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: In 1748 he was ordered to Jinchuan and fought at Nangde Mountain Ridge.

sentences.zh: 攻碉先登，奪矛，中石，傷。

translations.literal: Attacking a blockhouse he was first to ascend, seized a spear, was struck by a stone, and wounded.
translations.idiomatic: Storming a blockhouse he was first over the wall, seized a spear, was hit by a stone, and wounded.

sentences.zh: 從攻普沾，擲火彈入碉，焚碉十三，奪木城。

translations.literal: He joined the attack on Puzhan, threw fire bombs into blockhouses, burned thirteen blockhouses, and seized a wooden fortress.
translations.idiomatic: At Puzhan he threw fire bombs into blockhouses, burned thirteen of them, and took a wooden fort.

sentences.zh: 進戰於樂利噶爾堤克，殪賊。

translations.literal: Advancing to fight at Leliga'erdike he killed rebels.
translations.idiomatic: At Leliga'erdike he killed rebels in the advance.

sentences.zh: 攻碉，右股中槍，傷。

translations.literal: Attacking a blockhouse he was shot in the right thigh and wounded.
translations.idiomatic: In another blockhouse assault he was shot in the right thigh.

sentences.zh: 錄功，擢四川威茂協右營都司。

translations.literal: His merit was recorded and he was promoted to company commander of the right battalion of the Weimao garrison in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: For his merit he was promoted to company commander of the Weimao right battalion in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 引見，賜大緞。

translations.literal: Received in audience, he was granted fine silk.
translations.idiomatic: At court audience he was granted fine silk.

sentences.zh: 雜穀土司蒼旺為亂，提督岳鍾琪檄進忠討之，奪銅砲一，斬馘數十，生擒二十五，降茶堡番民二千餘。

translations.literal: When the Zagu native chieftain Cangwang rebelled, Provincial Commander Yue Zhongqi ordered Jinzhong to suppress him; he seized one bronze cannon, beheaded several dozen, captured twenty-five alive, and received the submission of more than two thousand Chabao tribesmen.
translations.idiomatic: When Zagu chieftain Cangwang rebelled, Yue Zhongqi ordered Jinzhong against him; he took a bronze cannon, killed dozens, captured twenty-five alive, and received the submission of more than two thousand Chabao tribesmen.

sentences.zh: 自角木角溝入雜穀，獲蒼旺。

translations.literal: Entering Zagu from Jiaomujiao Ravine he captured Cangwang.
translations.idiomatic: Entering Zagu through Jiaomujiao Ravine he captured Cangwang.

sentences.zh: 累擢永寧協副將。

translations.literal: He was promoted successively to brigade deputy of the Yongning garrison.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to deputy commander at Yongning.

sentences.zh: 三十年，從將軍明瑞徵緬甸，進攻蠻結，克木卡十六，殪賊三，傷額，明日，仍裹創出戰。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year he followed General Ming Rui in the Burma campaign, advanced to attack Manjie, captured sixteen wooden barriers, killed three rebels, was wounded in the forehead, and the next day still went out to battle with his wounds bound.
translations.idiomatic: In 1765 he followed General Ming Rui against Burma, attacked Manjie, took sixteen wooden barriers, killed three rebels, was wounded in the forehead, and fought again the next day with his wounds bound.

sentences.zh: 事聞，賜孔雀翎，號法式善巴圖魯。

translations.literal: When this was reported he was granted the peacock feather and titled Fashishan Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: When this was reported he received the peacock feather and the title Fashishan Baturu.

sentences.zh: 擢雲南臨元鎮總兵。

translations.literal: He was promoted to regional commander of the Linyuan garrison in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to regional commander at Linyuan in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 明瑞令將五千人屯龍陵關備調遣。

translations.literal: Ming Rui ordered him to station five thousand men at Longling Pass ready for deployment.
